message.content: {"caption":"Flow diagram of a knowledge-incorporation process that turns passage-derived edits into an updated model evaluated on a question about the passage.","description":"The diagram is arranged left to right in three stages: Passage, Self-Edit, and Evaluation. The passage panel shows an Apollo program excerpt about Kennedy’s science adviser Jerome Wiesner. An initial language model, labeled LM with parameters θₜ, uses the passage to generate a self-edit statement about the Apollo program’s science-adviser position. That generated statement is used in an SFT update, producing a model labeled with updated parameters θ′ₜ. In the evaluation panel, the updated model answers a question about who opposed manned spacecraft flights, without the passage shown as input; the displayed answer is Jerome Wiesner, marked correct.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
